description: Check only the BIMI (Brand Indicators for Message Identification) DNS record for a domain — faster than bimi_vmc because it skips the VMC certificate download and validation. Returns the BIMI record at default._bimi.<domain>, logo URL, and authority (VMC) URL if declared.

domain.description: Domain name to check the BIMI record for (e.g. easydmarc.com)

name: bimi_check
